Uttar Pradesh CM Showers Flower Petals on Kanwariyas

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath showered flower petals on Kanwariyas in Meerut. The Kanwariyas were travelling as part of their annual pilgrimage. The event took place in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh.
